snippet.title: Songs of Silence - Celestial Church Expansion Trailer
snippet.description:
Wield the full powers of the Celestial Church in both Campaign and Skirmish, with this Songs of Silence expansion!

🟠 Steam — https://store.steampowered.com/app/4179260/Songs_of_Silence__Celestial_Church_Expansion/?utm_campaign=CC-Exp-Launch&utm_source=YouTube&utm_medium=Trailer
⚫ Epic Games Store — https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/songs-of-silence-songs-of-silence-celestial-church-expansion-6516f2
🟣 GOG — https://www.gog.com/en/game/songs_of_silence_celestial_church_expansion

⛪ What's new in the Celestial Church Expansion?
New Campaign arc! 👑
- New characters, fully voiced dialogues
- 4 new chapters

New Skirmish faction! ⚔️
- 2 new hero classes
- 6 new hero vocations
- 8 new units
- 5 new strategy cards (including 2 new building upgrades)
- 5 new battles cards
- 4 new unit perks
- 1 new capital

📜 Official Website — songs-of-silence.com
📰 Press Kit – https://impress.games/press-kit/rcp/songs-of-silence

#SongsOfSilence #ArtNouveau #4X #TurnBasedStrategy #IndieGame
